verdict.rationale: Cactus ships its own CLI (`brew install`, `cactus run`, `cactus benchmark`). `cactus convert [HF-Name]` can pull in any HuggingFace model, though the docs call this experimental. That gives a thin, partial path to acquiring models from the command line. missing for 10: a documented CLI model search command, an explicit CLI download/pull command, and model management commands (list, delete, update), plus independent hands-on corroboration of CLI model workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: Any HuggingFace model can be converted using cactus convert [HF-Name], though experimental.
Step 1: brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus - Step 2: cactus run
